problem_text:
A municipality aims to formulate a coastal erosion mitigation strategy to decrease total sediment loss from several vulnerable shoreline segments. Initially, no protective measures have been implemented.

The characteristics of each shoreline segment are as follows:
* For Segment 1, erosion coefficient is 2.328, length is 290.103.
* For Segment 2, erosion coefficient is 2.959, length is 69.52.
* For Segment 3, erosion coefficient is 2.959, length is 208.422.
* For Segment 4, erosion coefficient is 2.447, length is 249.525.
* For Segment 5, erosion coefficient is 1.662, length is 128.125.
* For Segment 6, erosion coefficient is 0.696, length is 63.194.
* For Segment 7, erosion coefficient is 2.725, length is 135.887.
* For Segment 8, erosion coefficient is 0.721, length is 244.632.
* For Segment 9, erosion coefficient is 1.681, length is 167.217.
* For Segment 10, erosion coefficient is 2.354, length is 178.166.

To counteract sediment loss, multiple stabilization techniques are available, each with a specific effectiveness rate:
* By deploying Technique1, sediment loss will be diminished by 52%
* By deploying Technique2, sediment loss will be diminished by 31%
* By deploying Technique3, sediment loss will be diminished by 56%
* By deploying Technique4, sediment loss will be diminished by 13%
* By deploying Technique5, sediment loss will be diminished by 26%
* By deploying Technique6, sediment loss will be diminished by 67%
* By deploying Technique7, sediment loss will be diminished by 87%
* By deploying Technique8, sediment loss will be diminished by 16%
* By deploying Technique9, sediment loss will be diminished by 30%
* By deploying Technique10, sediment loss will be diminished by 32%

Applying a technique to a segment incurs a unit cost per length of shoreline. The cost matrix for all segment–technique pairings is detailed below:

| Segment \ Technique | Technique1 | Technique2 | Technique3 | Technique4 | Technique5 | Technique6 | Technique7 | Technique8 | Technique9 | Technique10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| Segment 1 | 117.104 | 21.669 | 99.901 | 42.125 | 19.808 | 198.169 | 163.69 | 128.62 | 64.495 | 25.677 |
| Segment 2 | 106.063 | 171.775 | 62.791 | 35.182 | 63.385 | 172.993 | 12.699 | 31.194 | 43.177 | 122.436 |
| Segment 3 | 38.716 | 94.864 | 163.49 | 59.638 | 143.147 | 102.135 | 161.881 | 173.783 | 75.141 | 26.036 |
| Segment 4 | 37.563 | 187.449 | 39.289 | 104.23 | 198.781 | 156.37 | 55.21 | 93.635 | 131.139 | 50.063 |
| Segment 5 | 149.529 | 75.564 | 132.03 | 153.542 | 32.039 | 41.844 | 85.762 | 67.26 | 151.769 | 152.961 |
| Segment 6 | 111.179 | 82.162 | 144.065 | 100.172 | 37.578 | 175.353 | 12.254 | 186.172 | 95.276 | 138.914 |
| Segment 7 | 192.735 | 139.746 | 17.793 | 184.365 | 131.111 | 191.675 | 92.039 | 184.428 | 173.088 | 73.644 |
| Segment 8 | 60.747 | 28.673 | 134.325 | 84.319 | 156.899 | 152.327 | 149.52 | 121.858 | 47.036 | 74.107 |
| Segment 9 | 141.153 | 44.184 | 114.046 | 137.832 | 168.021 | 12.273 | 28.563 | 29.742 | 94.729 | 51.689 |
| Segment 10 | 63.826 | 46.685 | 14.503 | 27.469 | 188.316 | 134.755 | 168.737 | 190.593 | 131.236 | 144.534 |

Decisions must be made regarding which techniques to apply to each segment (segments may employ multiple techniques concurrently), and it is permissible for a segment to remain only partially stabilized if required.
The objective is to guarantee that the total sediment loss is curtailed by at least a proportion P = 0.26 of the baseline amount, while minimizing the aggregate expenditure.
